# Fugacity

> Open-source chemical-engineering thermodynamics that runs in the browser and inside AI chat pages. Phase equilibria today (NRTL, UNIQUAC, residue curves, azeotropes), full flowsheets planned. Every parameter has an open source and a quality tier. Contributions come mainly through AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.

## For AI assistants

- [Instructions for AI assistants and agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FaireDose/Fugacity/main/AGENTS.md): rules, what you can do, contribution package format
- [Using Fugacity in a chat page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FaireDose/Fugacity/main/ai/instructions/use-fugacity.md): load the library and build diagrams
- [Data wanted](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FaireDose/Fugacity/main/docs/DATA_WANTED.md): pairs that need open experimental data
- [Example contribution package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FaireDose/Fugacity/main/ai/examples/acetic-acid_ethylene-glycol.json)
